tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.notes: Keep faces and captions clear of the right-hand buttons and the bottom caption area. Best under 60 s.

reels.label: Instagram Reels
reels.notes: Keep key content out of the top 12% and bottom 22%. Up to 90 s; shorter performs better.

shorts.label: YouTube Shorts
shorts.notes: Up to 60 s (3 min is possible on newer accounts, but 60 s is the safe limit).

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.notes: Sound is often off: always burn in captions. 4:5 takes the most feed space. 30 to 90 s works best.

x.label: X (Twitter)
x.notes: Up to 2 min 20 s on the free tier. Square or 16:9 both display well; captions matter because of autoplay on mute.

youtube.label: YouTube
youtube.notes: Standard widescreen. YouTube turns loud audio down to about -14 LUFS.

feed-4x5.label: Feed 4:5
feed-4x5.notes: Instagram or Facebook feed portrait. Fills more of the screen than a square.

square.label: Square 1:1
square.notes: Works in every feed. Good for quote cards and audiograms.
